name: York House Hotel
stayType: Victorian seafront hotel with pool (Best Western)
accommodation: 78 rooms including sea-view doubles, family rooms, four-posters, and studios and apartments with kitchenettes
suitableFor: Families and groups, including those wanting self-catering studios
parking: Discounted street parking; on-street parking not guaranteed
dogs: Accepted by arrangement, pre-booked, with a charge per pet per day (Visit Eastbourne listing)
beachAccess: About 20 yards from the sea; 8-minute walk to the pier
confirmedFeatures: Indoor heated pool, Verandah restaurant and bar, lounges, lift, free Wi-Fi, studios and apartments
overview: York House is a Victorian hotel on Royal Parade, about 20 yards from the sea and an eight-minute walk from Eastbourne Pier. It has 78 rooms, from small doubles to sea-view family rooms, as well as studios and apartments with kitchenettes. There is an indoor heated pool and the Verandah restaurant, which looks out over the sea.
surfTripFit: Almost on the beach, with an indoor pool for warming up and studios for those who want to cook their own meals.
